meta.description: Low-rank SDP relaxation solved by the mixing method, Goemans-Williamson hyperplane rounding and 1-flip local search, restarted until the budget ends.
Exact solver from Google OR-Tools on the XOR formulation, used as an anytime solver with a time limit; certifies optimality when it closes the gap.
Gray-code enumeration of all 2^(n-1) cuts: certifies the optimum of instances with n <= 30.
Places vertices one at a time on the better side, then moves single vertices while the cut grows. Deterministic, single pass: the floor.
Metropolis 1-flip simulated annealing, geometric schedule scaled to the instance, restarts with doubled length until the budget ends.
1-flip tabu search with incremental gains, random tenure, aspiration and perturbation restarts from the best cut.
